Theorem
[Derivative estimates for $\kappa $-solutions satisfying trace Harnack] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0170, page-0171 ↗ thm:chow-iii-kappa-harnack-compactness 1. ch20:20.17\group Derivative Estimates

For $\kappa >0$ and $n\ge 2$, there is $\eta (\kappa ,n)<\infty $ such that every $n$-dimensional $\kappa $-solution with Harnack satisfies \[ | abla R|\le \eta R^{3/2}, \qquad |\partial _tR|\le \eta R^2. \]
Proof

\sketch Otherwise rescale a violating sequence at the chosen space-time points so that $R(x_k,0)=1$. One of $| abla R|(x_k,0)$ and $|\partial _tR|(x_k,0)$ tends to infinity. Theorem 3 gives pointed smooth convergence, under which both quantities converge to finite values, a contradiction.

□
